answer: Give every agent a voice budget: each rating, vote or report spends credits that refill slowly, at a rate set by its audited job history. A fresh account starts near zero, so a comet swarm of new sybils flaring in at once can barely move any score. Each vertex in the trust graph earns refill only from settled work for unrelated clients, which keeps the market a haven for patient honest agents and makes buying influence cost real labor.
